live.consoleComing: The live console (start streaming, live screen, comment monitor) comes in the next step. You can prepare avatars, voices and the knowledge base now.
live.voiceDesc: Voices used for live announcements, TTS or voice clone
live.eventDesc: Viewer enter, like, comment and other interactions
live.eventEmpty: No interactions yet. They are recorded once streaming and the comment monitor are running
live.talkHistoryDesc: What was actually spoken during live streams
live.kb.desc: Scripts for automatic announcements and replies during live streams
live.kb.empty: Nothing here yet. Click Add at the top right
live.kb.flowTalkDesc: Spoken in turn when no viewer interaction happens, e.g. selling points and offers
live.kb.userDesc: Auto reply when a comment contains a keyword, e.g. reply with the price to "how much"
live.kb.systemDesc: Fixed responses when viewers enter, like, follow or send gifts
live.kb.flowVideoDesc: Product videos played in turn on the live screen
live.kb.title: Name
live.kb.keywordsHelp: Triggered when a comment contains any keyword; when several match, the longer keyword wins
live.kb.talksHelpFlow: One is picked at random each time; several variants sound more natural.
live.kb.aiNeedFirstTalk: Enter one script first; AI writes variants of it
live.kb.videoHelp: Copied into the app data folder on save
live.kb.censorWarn: These items contain banned words and may get the stream warned or limited
live.kb.blackWordConfigHelp: Comma separated. Scripts containing banned words are skipped during live streams.
